Laws of chemical combination: Mass is conserved in reactions; a compound has fixed mass ratios, e.g. H : O = 1 : 8 in water.
Dalton's atomic theory, atoms and molecu: Dalton: matter is made of atoms combining in fixed ratios. Molecules are bonded groups of atoms.
Atomic and molecular mass, ions and chem: Molecular mass is the sum of atomic masses. Formulae follow valencies, e.g. Al₂O₃.
The mole concept and Avogadro number: 1 mole = 6.022 × 10²³ particles; moles = mass / molar mass.
